t.Across back: halfway between A and C, me: Kọja sẹhin: agbedemeji laarin A ati C, wọn idaji kọja ẹhin pẹlu 0.5 cm: 17.5 + 0.5 = 18 cm. Fa igun apa apa lati aaye ejika, nipasẹ ami yii, isalẹ si D.
